title: Comprehensive anatomical part library
selected_by_owner: Owner Continue following delivery of CHU-01; cumulative standalone HTML scope.

in_scope: Expand reusable anatomical vocabulary across conventional, botanical, fungal, ooze, synthetic and supernatural forms.
Preserve exact ICF-08 baseline tendencies as reference; candidate mappings and historical evidence review, no automatic creature assignments.
Provide searchable, filterable cumulative standalone HTML and portable part library plus proposal queue/export.
boundaries: All 287 part entries are proposals, not new canonical anatomy or ingredient definitions. 114 candidate mappings are not approved tendency grants; 173 unmapped candidates remain unresolved.
Historical evidence links include seven signature identities and two explicitly ambiguous candidate mappings for Rift-Touched Animal, not executable harvest profiles.
No body-plan population, quantity, yield, edibility, exact effects, safety, legality, live game mutations or native certification. Construct components may route to LSS rather than ICF.
